design:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: CHARACTER DESIGN MODEL SHEET for a 2D hand-drawn music PV "流萤来了哦". Input 1 is a STYLE reference only from the provided original clip: absorb its warm dark olive-brown, slightly wobbling bold outlines, extremely simple flat coloring, white paper, doodle-chibi proportions about 3 heads tall, sparse facial details and enormous expressive oval eyes. Do not copy the original characters.
Create one landscape model sheet, clean white background, four clearly separated large sections. Main Firefly front view + right-facing profile + back view occupy left two thirds. Right third: one full-body female Trailblazer STELLE and one tiny SD SAM mech plus a row of three Firefly facial expressions. Consistent Firefly in all views: recognizable Honkai Star Rail Firefly, long SILVER/very pale mint hair fading light seafoam at the ends, unbraided straight flowing hair, black headband with two feather/leaf ornaments, teal eyes with tiny rose accents, white inner high-collar dress, BLACK short cape-like outer jacket with green lining, mint-green skirt panels and dark hem, dark short boots and dark stockings. Simplify tiny details to match reference, keep this recognizable black-white-mint silhouette. Cute youthful gentle but firm, casual warm smile, not a generic schoolgirl; NO orange bow, NO twin braids. STELLE: female, ash-grey shoulder-length hair, golden eyes, black/grey long jacket with gold trim over white top, black skirt/shorts, deadpan affectionate expression. SAM: stubby SILVER armoured robot with angular helmet, black joints, tiny green luminous visor and green chest; cute comic counterpart, no battle scene.
Flat single-color fills with no gradients, NO 3D, NO realistic shading, NO glossy anime illustration rendering. Rough-but-clean brown hand-drawn contours same visual grammar as source. Use only very small green/glowing firefly accents. Minimal neutral labels only FIRE FLY, STELLE, SAM or no text. Hands anatomically clean. Entire silhouettes visible and widely spaced; useful for consistent animation assets. This is a production reference, not a finished scene.
poses_a:
Input 1 is the APPROVED design sheet. Preserve this exact Firefly identity, outfit, headband ornament, hair length, chibi face, palette, dark brown sketch contours in every pose. Input 2 is only the original hand-drawn PV style: make assets flatter, SIMPLER, doodlier and less shaded than the design sheet, with solid olive-brown outlines and flat minimal cream/pale mint hair, mint teal skirt, white inner dress, black jacket, dark stockings and boots. About 3 heads tall, original cartoon animation vocabulary. No glossy rendering or gradients. Not 3D, not live action. NO braided hair. This is an animation sprite atlas: true TRANSPARENT background, no white rectangles, no grid lines, no labels, no speech balloons, no text. Fixed regular layout, 4 equal columns by 3 equal rows. Every cell contains EXACTLY one Firefly full-body sprite, centered, in identical base scale, entire figure visible, clean isolated silhouette, generous transparent gutters all around. 2048x1536 landscape if possible. Cells must never overlap. Keep ALL designs consistent; only change pose/expression. Accurate two arms, two legs, tidy stylized hands.
Pose order MUST be exactly row-major left to right:
row 1: 1. Front open-mouth excited arrival greeting with both arms relaxed outward; 2. Front surprised small O mouth and hands at sides; 3. Both hands raised near shoulders, joyful closed-eye smile, little celebratory jump; 4. Friendly confident one hand on hip, other pointing sideways.
row 2: 5. Right-facing running contact pose, right knee forward, other leg back, elbows bent, hair flowing left; 6. Right-facing running passing pose, opposite legs alternate naturally and elbows bend, hair flowing left; 7. Seated seiza on knees EATING an oak swiss-roll cake held in TWO hands, cute puffed cheeks; 8. Seated same silhouette blissful closed-eye smile eating same cake.
row 3: 9. Wide-eyed delighted discovery, one finger raised and other hand open, full body; 10. Silly flailing surprised hop, two clean bent legs and two spread hands; 11. Front bashful warm smiling with both hands gently clasped at chest; 12. Full-body cheerful eyes-closed singing, BOTH hands holding a small simple dark brown microphone in front of chest.
No decorative particles around sprites: compositor will add those separately.

support:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: supporting character animation SPRITE ATLAS for "流萤来了哦". Reference 1 APPROVED character design: exact Stelle and SAM appearance. Reference 2 original PV STYLE only: thick warm olive-brown hand-drawn outlines, super simplified flat colors, white interior areas but TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND outside silhouettes. NO gradients. NO 3D. NO orange bows or purple braids. No text, no panel lines, no speech bubbles. Fixed regular 4 columns x 3 rows grid, generous gaps, each cell one isolated centered sprite, cell objects NEVER cross cell edges.
Row 1 cells 1-4: ONLY half-body FEMALE STELLE from head to waist, proportion enlarged head, hands holding a simple game controller. Ash grey loose shoulder-length hair, golden eyes, black/grey long jacket gold trim over white top. Cell1: neutral deadpan looking ahead with controller, Cell2: eyes looking RIGHT curious with controller, Cell3: startled wide eyes and tiny open mouth with controller, Cell4: eyes closed softly smiling with controller.
Row 2 cells5-8: four FULL-BODY STELLE, consistent 3-heads-tall. Cell5: neutral standing holding an oak cake roll with both hands, Cell6: right-facing photo-camera held with two hands at chest, Cell7: sits on a little trash bin lid in a cute amused relaxed pose (entire grey bin included), Cell8: quietly happy full body wave LEFT with one hand, other at side.
Row3 cells9-12: tiny chibi SILVER SAM mecha with angular official helmet, black joints and GREEN visor/chest, not generic robot. Cell9: full-body standing bashful, one hand raised to wave. Cell10: same full-body goofy open-armed jump, little GREEN comic spark near head. Cell11: SAM helmet ONLY icon, front/3-quarter with bright green visor; no body. Cell12: a small elegant handheld transformation device ONLY, white-black metal with luminous green center, held by NO hands.
Keep shapes and hand anatomy readable at small scale. No battles or aggression. Light comedic supporting assets.

title:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: FULL FRAME TITLE BACKGROUND / hero key art for a cute 2D hand-drawn PV. Reference1 original title composition: big excited character on RIGHT, dramatic bright colored burst, generously empty LEFT for a huge two-line title; pointer at bottom. Reference2 approved model sheet: exact Firefly design and palette. Rebuild as a Firefly-themed title image, wide 16:9 canvas 1920x1080.
RIGHT half: expressive comic Firefly half body, long flowing pale silver-to-mint hair, black headband with pale feather ornaments, teal huge oval eyes, rosy cheeks, open silly joyful grin, not scary, white inner dress with black cape-like short jacket and mint lining, same little green-gold chest ornament. She holds a thin sparkling wand/pointer diagonally across the bottom toward LEFT. The pose echoes the original title composition but fits her gentle playful nature.
Background is a hand-painted radial comic burst with bright MINT / creamy lemon / white rays, a few warm peach sparks, tiny firefly dots, a few paper-stars and leaf-like shapes. Energetic yet warm and cute. Mostly light palette, crisp black-brown outlines, flat illustrated colors with only modest paper texture for this title. Do NOT use orange schoolgirl uniform or original source characters. NOT 3D, NOT photoreal, NOT cinematic painting.
LEFT HALF needs large clear negative area, patterned burst is okay but no characters and NO TEXT whatsoever because exact Chinese title will be added by compositor. NO letters, labels, watermark, badges. No mini characters; they will animate separately. Entire 16:9 image filled edge to edge, no border or collage. One unified composition. Preserve the right-side face and lower wand position from original but make it unmistakably Firefly.
